section_summary.extract_value: This section details Study 2, which aimed to investigate the criterion and predictive validity of the Creativity Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ). Participants, identified as students, completed the CAQ and created a collage, which was subsequently evaluated by expert judges using the Consensual Assessment Technique (CAT). The central hypothesis was that CAQ scores would positively predict the experts' creativity ratings of the collages.
